bio.text: Kevin Mullin represents California's 15th Congressional District in the U.S. House, where he took office in January 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

According to his House website, he served on the South San Francisco City Council from 2007 to 2012 (mayor in 2011) and in the California State Assembly from 2012 to 2022, where he was Speaker pro Tem from 2014.
He graduated from Junipero Serra High School in San Mateo and the University of San Francisco, and holds a master's degree from San Francisco State University.
He founded the communications firm KM2 Communications.
